head: feature/F-FND
title: M0 Foundation complete: T-001…T-008 (F-FND-001…008)
body:
# M0 — Foundation close-out (T-001 → T-008)

Closes the entire `Phase 0-Foundation` milestone. All eight foundation tasks (F-FND-001…F-FND-008) are implemented and verified; this is a docs-sweep PR marking the remaining rows done plus one final gate run.

## What landed on this branch (52 commits)

| Task | Feature | Key deliverables |
|---|---|---|
| T-049 (T-001) | F-FND-001 Solution scaffold | 5 src projects + 3 test projects + wa.web (Vite/React/TS), .NET 10 pin, layer rules proven with a first use case |
| T-050 (T-002) | F-FND-002 Local tooling & health | docker-compose.local.yml (SQL 2022 + Azurite), §5.2 env vars, `/health` DB+SB ping, Serilog console at TA-10.5 levels |
| T-051 (T-003) | F-FND-003 CI pipeline | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` TA-12.1 job set, multi-stage Dockerfile + .dockerignore, gitattributes determinism |
| T-052 (T-004) | F-FND-004 Domain model & schema | 15 POCOs (BCL-only wa.domain), `WaDbContext` + per-entity configurations, InitialCreate migration cross-checked vs TA-3.2, seed migration (3 plans + full flag set), Testcontainers seed test |
| T-053 (T-005) | F-FND-005 Limits Registry | `LimitsRecord`, `ILimitsProvider`, PlansCache/FlagsCache 30 s TTL, flag override mechanics + unit tests |
| T-054 (T-006) | F-FND-006 Event backbone | TA-5.2 envelope, outbox same-transaction publish, SB adapter, in-memory fake, 15-min LRU eventId dedup |
| T-055 (T-007) | F-FND-007 Blob foundation | `IBlobStore` port + Azure/Azurite adapters, SAS minting TA-3.6 exact URL forms, canonical staging path helper, round-trip integration test |
| T-056 (T-008) | F-FND-008 Pipeline foundation | W3C traceparent parsing + correlationId in every response/log context, Problem+JSON closed code list (TA-4.1.3), CORS allow-list with Vary:Origin, auth rate limit 5/min/IP → 429 RATE_LIMITED + Retry-After (AspNetCoreRateLimit 5.0.0), TA-10.2 telemetry closed set (21 events + 7 metrics) |

## Gate at HEAD (re-run for this sweep)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `dotnet test tests/wa.domain.unit` | 37/37 passed |
| `dotnet test tests/wa.application.unit` | 33/33 passed |
| `dotnet test tests/wa.api.integration` | 13/13 passed (Testcontainers SQL + Azurite) |
| `src/wa.web`: lint / test / build | clean / 1/1 / built |

## This commit's changes (docs sweep)

- **T-052-02** task doc: exit checklist boxes flipped `[x]` — verified against the live code (`WaDbContext.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly`; 16 configuration classes present, including T-054's `DomainEventsConfiguration`).
- **F-FND-004 story table**: T-052-02 row ☐ → ☑ (the only remaining unchecked Foundation task row — all other F-FND rows were already ☑ from their own PRs).
- **Milestone-Backlog.md**: `T-001`/`T-004`/`T-005` pending → done. These three rows were never flipped by a prior docs commit (T-049 landed on main before the F-FND branch split; T-052/T-053 commits closed their task-doc boxes but skipped the milestone row). M0 is now fully `done`: T-001…T-008 all green.

## Exit checks covered

- **AC-052 exit** (schema): migrations create all tables on SQL 2022, seed rows verifiable (`SeedDataIntegrationTest`), wa.domain zero external refs (dependency audit T-049-07 + BCL-only POCOs).
- **T-005 exit**: unit tests cover per-plan resolution, flag override wins, TTL expiry honored.
- **T-008 exit**: 404/500 return Problem+JSON with correlationId; `upload_started`-style event emitted with exact template (PipelineTests, T-056-05).

## Notes for the merge

- Base is `main`; this PR contains every commit since main diverged (`b3fca0b`) — 52 commits. CI runs on all of them.
- Open `TBD-you` decisions (D-07/D-12/D-13/D-16…) don't block M0: they gate later milestones per `Open-Decisions-and-Constants.md` Part 1.
